title: Locally closed extension of internal coefficient modules
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $X$ a topologically Noetherian scheme. Let $a:S\hookrightarrow X$ be a locally closed immersion, in the sense of [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Factor $a=i\circ j$ through its canonical scheme-theoretic image, where $j=a.\mathrm{toImage}$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] and $i=a.\mathrm{image\iota}$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. The locally closed coefficient extension is the functor $a_!:=i_*\circ j_!:\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_S}\to\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$, using the coefficient-module open extension by zero of [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek] followed by the coefficient-module direct image of [def-sfb-module-lower-star]. Here $\Lambda_Y=p_Y^*\Lambda$ and these are internal modules in abelian sheaves on the small pro-etale site, as in the cited module-functor definitions. The construction uses the actual canonical factorization and these actual functors, with no choice of support functor. Empty schemes and the zero module are included.
